scope: Proposition 4.7 (The multiplicative Euler layer) of the manuscript “Finite Smith–Toda Complexes at Varying Primes” (preprints/Finite-Smith-Toda-Complexes-at-Varying-Primes-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 308 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 13dce3978089a78f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every sequence of graded commutative algebras X, there are natural product-compatible equivalences B(X)//t ≃ − → Φ(X) ≃ ← − Q(X) ⊗D (D//ϖ). (4.5) The right-hand comparison applies to arbitrary spectrum inputs as well. The scalar action in the δ direction agrees with ordinary evaluation on Q(X) followed by reduction. The comparisons are compatible with algebra units and maps of inputs. The first map uses the tautological Euler null on S(2V ), restricted to S(V ).
